question: Identify the goods whose demand falls due to the fall in their price.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Giffen goods.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In economics and consumer theory, a** Giffen good is a product that people consume more of as the price rises.** Thus, it **violates the law of demand** by showing an **upwards-sloping curve** of demand.
 
• Giffen good denotes non-luxury and inferior products with very little or no substitutes. Example - **wheat, potatoes, and rice.**
 
• The term Giffen goods are **coined **after the name of the late Scottish **economist Sir R. Giffen in the 1800s.**
 
• Giffen good is considered to be the** opposite of an ordinary/normal good.**

**​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• **Normal goods **are products whose** demand increases as consumer income increase****s and decreases as consumer income decreases **whereas Giffen good is a lower quality product whose demand grows as their value rises.
 
• An **inferior good** is a type of good whose **demand declines when income rises.** Example - **Jaggery**
 
• A **substitute good **is a product or service that a consumer sees as the** same or similar to another product.**
